scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.test: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:core && pnpm run lint:browser
scripts.lint:browser: cd native/swirldb-browser && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:fix:core && pnpm run lint:fix:browser
scripts.lint:fix:browser: cd native/swirldb-browser && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features -- -D warnings
